title: Chess Piece of Fate
next_chapter_hook: The Tianji Record suddenly displayed a countdown: 30 days until Chen Nian's sacrifice.

text.content:
The power of foresight surged into his Brow Center like a tidal wave, and Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

That face finally became clear—not a person, but a vertical pupil spanning the Void, its depths flowing with countless visions: stars falling, mortals wailing, countless cultivators struggling within the threads of fate. And he, Chen Ji, was merely one of countless nodes entangled in those interwoven threads.

"So that's how it is." Chen Ji's voice was unusually calm, as if he had long anticipated this, a self-deprecating smile even appearing at the corner of his lips, "I had been wondering who was watching me in the shadows. The answer is so simple—it is the will of this heaven and earth itself."

The moment the third page seal of the Tianji Record was lifted, countless fragments of information pierced into his mind like needles.

Chen Ji saw his own past—every vision of the future, every struggle at the edge of Heavenly Fate Value, every layout he had thought was flawless... all under the gaze of that vertical pupil. He had thought he was playing a grand game of chess, unaware that he had been a piece on the chessboard from the very beginning.

"Ridiculous?" Chen Ji murmured to himself, his fingertips tapping lightly on his knee, "No, not ridiculous. Being observed by the Heavenly Dao means I still have value to be exploited."

Just then, the seal on the first page of the Tianji Record trembled slightly, and an aged voice resounded in his mind.

"You've finally seen it." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested, a rare hint of relief appearing on that ethereal face, "Being gazed upon by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets means the inheritor of the Tianji Record has finally grown to a degree that warrants its attention." Chen Ji coldly laughed: "Attention? Attention enough to use me as a chess piece until I die?" Mo Xiansheng shook his head: "No, you've only seen the first layer."

dialogue.content:
"The Eye of Heavenly Secrets never does anything without purpose." Mo Xiansheng's voice was ethereal and profound, "In every era, it selects a prophet, granting them the ability to glimpse Heavenly Secrets, then watches them struggle, grow, and finally..."

"Finally be squeezed dry of every last shred of value?" Chen Ji interjected, his tone icy.

"No." Mo Xiansheng revealed a meaningful smile, "Finally, to see if they possess the qualification to break the chess game."

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, his mind racing.

Previous prophets... he had glimpsed fragments about them in the Tianji Record's pages. All of them had once shaken the world, all had believed they could change their fate, yet without exception, they all vanished into the long river of history. They were all chess pieces.

But—if the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' purpose was merely to obtain chess pieces, why grant them the ability to see the future? Why let them grow to such a degree?

"You're cultivating a game-breaker." Chen Ji lifted his head abruptly, his eyes flashing with brilliance, "Those dead prophets were all failed products you eliminated. And me..."

dialogue.content:
"And you are the one closest to success." Mo Xiansheng's smile deepened, "The higher the Tianji Record's completion, the stronger the prophet's abilities, but also..."

"Also meaning the stronger the backlash." Chen Ji finished, having understood completely, "It's using my growth to feed the Tianji Record, while simultaneously testing me through the Record's completeness. When the completion reaches a certain critical point—"

"That is the final trial." Mo Xiansheng nodded, "Either become its puppet completely, or..."

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond at this critical moment when he realizes the true purpose of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, his heart churning?

choices.description: Since it wants to cultivate a game-breaker, follow its intent and weave one's own chess game within its chess game. Actively enter the game, actively break the game.
choices.visible_cost: Exposed under the complete gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets
choices.visible_reward: Obtain deeper permissions of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Once failed, become a puppet forever

text.content: "Good." Chen Ji's voice was low and firm, "Since it wants to see a good show, I'll perform for it. However—" a cold light flickered in his eyes, "actors can also rewrite the script."

choices.description: Cannot act rashly. Since I know I'm a chess piece, I must hide my abilities and bide my time, accumulating strength in the shadows, waiting for the opportunity to strike with certainty.
choices.visible_cost: Need more time to lay out plans
choices.risk_hint: Time waits for no one, and my sister's situation grows ever more dangerous

text.content: "No rush." Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down, "Since it's cultivating me, there must still be time. I need more information, more bargaining chips... before it closes its net, I need to arrange my backup plans."

choices.description: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets also has weaknesses. Since the Tianji Record is a chess piece it set in motion, start from the chess piece itself and find loopholes in the rules.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Eye of Heavenly Secrets
choices.visible_reward: Discover hidden functions of the Tianji Record
choices.process_label: 陈机开始研究天机录本质

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, sinking his consciousness deep into the Tianji Record. Not to use its abilities, but to touch its essence—those rules that constitute it, those constraints it must abide by.

"Since it's a chess piece, there are rules for chess pieces." He murmured to himself, "And rules... are meant to be broken."

Just then, a Spiritual Energy fluctuation penetrated Chen Ji's defenses, forcibly establishing a connection with him.

It was the Old Sect Master, Ling Yuan.

"Chen Ji, this old one knows you've seen it." Ling Yuan's voice was sinister, carrying an inexplicable nuance, "The Tianji Record is 40% complete, enough for you to see some interesting things. For instance—where your sister, missing for many years, currently is."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's gaze instantly turned ice-cold.

One of the things he detested most was someone threatening him with Chen Nian. This old coot had clearly aimed at precisely this weakness.

"Ling Sect Master certainly has sharp intelligence." Chen Ji's tone was terrifyingly calm, "Speak. What do you want?"

"Ha ha ha, truly one this old one admires." Ling Yuan's laughter echoed within the Spiritual Energy connection, "Relax, this old one is not here to threaten you. On the contrary, I've come to offer you a great fortune."

"Fortune?" Chen Ji coldly laughed, "Ling Sect Master's fortune is probably stained with blood."

"That depends on who you ask." Ling Yuan's voice suddenly became meaningful, "Heavenly Fate Key—you should know what that is, right? Within Chen Nian's body is sealed a key to open a certain Ancient Forbidden Land. And within that Forbidden Land... lies the answer you seek."

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart skipped a beat.

Heavenly Fate Key. Ancient Forbidden Land. These keywords had appeared countless times in the Tianji Record's pages, but each time they were like shrouded in mist, never quite clear. Yet now, Ling Yuan had actively delivered this information to him.

But he knew Ling Yuan too well. This old fox never made a losing trade. His active disclosure of this information must have deeper scheming behind it.

dialogue.content:
"Ling Sect Master's kindness, Chen Ji accepts." Chen Ji's voice was indifferent, "But Chen Ji understands the principle of not accepting gifts without merit. Ling Sect Master, speak your conditions directly."

Silence hung on the other end of the Spiritual Energy connection for a moment.

"Direct!" Ling Yuan laughed heartily, "My condition is simple—in thirty days, the Demonic Path Holy Sect will hold a grand sacrifice at their altar. Your sister Chen Nian is one of the sacrificial offerings. I want you to disrupt that sacrifice."

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

Thirty days. Sacrifice. Chen Nian.

These three words were like three daggers, cruelly piercing his heart. He had always known Chen Nian's situation was dangerous, but he hadn't expected the danger to have reached this degree. Sacrifice—what it meant, he knew better than anyone.

"Why do you want me to disrupt the sacrifice?" Chen Ji's voice was low, "What benefit is it to you?"

dialogue.content:
"Because once that sacrifice succeeds, it brings no benefit to this old one either." Ling Yuan's voice turned icy, "The Demonic Path Holy Sect wants to open that Forbidden Land, and I will not permit it. The things within that Forbidden Land... should belong to the Tianqing Sect—to me, Ling Yuan."

Chen Ji fell silent for a moment.

Ling Yuan's words were half-truth and half-lie, but one thing he could be certain of: Ling Yuan truly did not want the sacrifice to succeed. This meant that on this point, he and Ling Yuan had a temporary alignment of interests.

text.content:
Just then, the Tianji Record suddenly operated on its own, and a blurry vision materialized before Chen Ji's eyes—

The altar. A bone altar towering into the clouds, surrounded by countless Demonic Path cultivators. And at the altar's center, a young woman in plain garments was bound by chains, gazing blankly at the sky. Her face bore a seven-tenth resemblance to Chen Ji's.

Chen Nian.

At the bottom of the vision, a chilling countdown appeared: 30 days.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record's countdown is like a death warrant. Facing the sacrifice thirty days from now, Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: Although Ling Yuan's intentions are sinister, my sister's safety comes first. Save Chen Nian first, then settle accounts with this old fox later.
choices.visible_cost: May fall into Ling Yuan's trap
choices.visible_reward: Obtain detailed intelligence about the sacrifice and the Forbidden Land
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's promises are never trustworthy

dialogue.content: "Very well." Chen Ji's voice carried not a trace of fluctuation, "In thirty days, I will appear at the altar. But Ling Sect Master—" his tone suddenly turned bone-chilling, "if Chen Nian suffers even a single mishap, I will have you buried."

choices.description: Ling Yuan cannot be trusted. My sister, I will save myself. Using the Tianji Record's foresight abilities, devise a rescue plan independently.
choices.visible_reward: Action is completely under one's own control

text.content: "No need." Chen Ji severed the Spiritual Energy connection, a cold smile curling at his lips, "The old fox wants to use me, but I refuse to be used as a weapon. Thirty days... is enough for me to lay an inescapable net in the shadows."

After Ling Yuan's Spiritual Energy dissipated, Chen Ji sat alone in the room, his fingers rhythmically tapping the table.

The Tianji Record's completion at forty percent. The third page seal released. He had seen the true face of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets and learned the truth of being a chess piece of fate.

But this did not mean despair.

"The first Chess Piece of Fate points to myself." Chen Ji said quietly, his eyes blazing with unprecedented brilliance, "Since I am a chess piece, let this piece... devour the entire game in reverse."

The Tianji Record warmed slightly in his palm, as if responding to his resolve.

Chen Ji closed his eyes, his consciousness once again sinking into that mysterious tome. This time, he was not simply using its abilities, but attempting to understand its essence.

As a chess piece of the Heavenly Dao's will, the Tianji Record must have its rules. And rules... are meant to be exploited.

"Thirty days." He murmured to himself, "Enough for me to play a grand game of chess."

Outside the window, the night was as deep as ink.

Chen Ji stood up, walked to the window, gazing at the distant Sect Gate of the Tianqing Sect. His eyes were deep and calm, as if everything was within his calculations.

From this moment on, he was no longer that passive废物 disciple who merely responded to fate. He would actively enter the game, and under the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, weave a chess game that belonged to himself.

Chen Nian, wait for me.

The Tianji Record suddenly flickered, and a cold countdown appeared before his eyes:

[Days until Chen Nian's sacrifice: 30]
